import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXV = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;

    static char[][] firstGrid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] secondGrid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] infectTime = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int N, timeLimit;
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static boolean isZeroToNine(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
    static boolean isOneToNine(char c) { return c >= '1' && c <= '9'; }

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        ArrayList<Edge>[] g;
        int[] level;
        boolean[] seen;

        Dinic() {
            g = new ArrayList[MAXV];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXV; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            level = new int[MAXV];
            seen = new boolean[MAXV];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            if (u == v) return;
            for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                if (e.to == v) {
                    e.cap = c;
                    g[v].get(e.rev).cap = 0;
                    return;
                }
            }
            Edge a = new Edge(v, g[v].size(), c);
            Edge b = new Edge(u, g[u].size(), 0);
            g[u].add(a);
            g[v].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            seen[u] = true;
            for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && !seen[e.to] && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                    int got = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                    if (got > 0) {
                        e.cap -= got;
                        g[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += got;
                        return got;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(seen, false);
                int got;
                while ((got = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) flow += got;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static Dinic solver = new Dinic();

    static void zombieTraversal(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(infectTime[i], INF);
        infectTime[sx][sy] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
                if (isZeroToNine(firstGrid[nx][ny]) && infectTime[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    infectTime[nx][ny] = infectTime[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addAllSourceEdges(int sx, int sy) {
        int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;

        if (isOneToNine(secondGrid[sx][sy]))
            solver.addEdge(N * sx + sy, N * N + N * sx + sy, INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
                if (dist[nx][ny] != INF) continue;
                if (!isZeroToNine(firstGrid[nx][ny])) continue;

                int nt = dist[x][y] + 1;
                if (nt <= Math.min(infectTime[nx][ny] - 1, timeLimit)) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = nt;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
                if (nt <= Math.min(infectTime[nx][ny], timeLimit) && isOneToNine(secondGrid[nx][ny]))
                    solver.addEdge(N * sx + sy, N * N + N * nx + ny, INF);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        int zx = 0, zy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                firstGrid[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (firstGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i; zy = j;
                } else if (isOneToNine(firstGrid[i][j])) {
                    solver.addEdge(MAXV - 2, i * N + j, firstGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        zombieTraversal(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                secondGrid[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (isOneToNine(secondGrid[i][j]))
                    solver.addEdge(N * N + i * N + j, MAXV - 1, secondGrid[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (isOneToNine(firstGrid[i][j])) addAllSourceEdges(i, j);

        System.out.println(solver.maxFlow(MAXV - 2, MAXV - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
